messages:
Linh Tran: prod alert: model-router.queue_depth p95 > 300 in prod-us-west-2. Noticed a bunch of repeats since ~01:10 UTC. Where's the best trace/dashboard to check? The alert card doesn't have a trace link.

oncall-bot: ALERT: model-router.queue_depth fired
Alert rule: model-router-queue-depth-prod-us-west-2
Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/model-router?orgId=1
Triggered at 2026-03-17T01:12:12Z

Sahil Gupta: Try the Grafana panel "Router - queues" -> "Queue depth by shard". Jaeger traces are at https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=model-router
Prom query (quick): `sum by(shard)(queue_depth{env=\"prod\",region=\"us-west-2\"})`

Maria Alvarez: We're running nightly indexing for embeds in that region — expected some bump. Can we mute for 20m while the job finishes so we don't get noisy pages?

Andre Kim: +1 to a short mute. If we do that, add the embed job id in the note and consider a temporary filter to ignore job-specific cardinality.

Linh Tran: I can create the mute. Sahil — want me to include the job id? It's `job-embed-20260317-01`.

Sahil Gupta: Yes include that. I'll also pause the Grafana alert for 20m. Using the API (example):
```
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" \
  "https://grafana.redwood.ai/api/alerts/12345/pause?paused=true&until=2026-03-17T01:32:00Z"
```
I'll paste confirmation when it's done.

oncall-bot: Action recorded: snooze requested by Sahil. Note id: INC-20260317-04

Sahil Gupta: Done. Paused for 20m. Annotation added: `snooze_reason: nightly-embed-job job-embed-20260317-01` :white_check_mark:

Maria Alvarez: Thanks — I'll monitor and post here if the job overruns.

Linh Tran: If the problem persists after unpause, where should I look for follow-up traces/spans? Any quick pointers?

Sahil Gupta: Check spans: `model-router.request`, `model-router.enqueue`, and `kv-cache.write`. Look for enqueue spikes + downstream latency. If both queue depth and `model-router.enqueue` errors increase, escalate to @eng-oncall and tag me.

Andre Kim: Also add a dashboard note on the panel with the job id and the pause window so runbooks see it later.

Linh Tran: Will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
